title: 3dLocalHistog
description: This program computes a local histogram at each voxel in the input datasets.

nbhd_option.description: Defines the region around each voxel to be used for the statistics calculation. Available formats: 'SPHERE(r)', 'RECT(a,b,c)', 'RHDD(a)', 'TOHD(a)'.
nbhd_option.title: Neighborhood String

prefix.description: Use string 'ppp' as the prefix for the output dataset.
prefix.title: Output Prefix

hsave.description: Save the overall histogram into file 'sss'. This file will have 2 columns: value and count.
hsave.title: Histogram Save File

lab_file.description: Use file 'LL' as a label file.
lab_file.title: Label File

exclude.description: Exclude values from 'a' to 'b' from the counting. This option can be used more than once.
exclude.title: Exclude Values

exc_nonlab.description: If '-lab_file' is used, then exclude all values that are NOT in the label file (except for 0).
exc_nonlab.title: Exclude Non-Labeled Values Flag

mincount.description: Exclude values which appear in the overall histogram fewer than 'mm' times.
mincount.title: Minimum Count

probability.description: Convert each count to a probability by dividing by the total number of counts at each voxel.
probability.title: Probability Flag

quiet.description: Stop the highly informative progress reports.
quiet.title: Quiet Flag
